provisionalCoreResponsibilities.name: ChallengeAssessmentContract
provisionalCoreResponsibilities.responsibility: Any Game challenge/difficulty claim must bind current evaluation criterion/authority, attribution target, condition/horizon and relevant control/observation/opponent/history context; the result is a query-specific identified/bounded projection rather than an intrinsic scalar.
provisionalCoreResponsibilities.ontologyNote: responsibility/claim contract, not new R29 primitive

provisionalCoreResponsibilities.name: FailureRecoveryContract
provisionalCoreResponsibilities.responsibility: Failure is evaluation/scope/horizon-relative nonattainment; when recovery is relevant, authoritative continuation transitions are represented separately from terminality and any query-specific cost/severity projection.
provisionalCoreResponsibilities.ontologyNote: responsibility contract over existing Evaluation + Transition/History coordinates

provisionalCoreResponsibilities.name: MasteryClaimContract
provisionalCoreResponsibilities.responsibility: Mastery is a scoped evidence claim over frozen SkillProfile under declared conditions/probes/attribution/currentness, not completion/high-score/zero-error/global Mastered state.
provisionalCoreResponsibilities.ontologyNote: evidence/claim contract, not new capability primitive

masteryNonCircularity.rule: The evaluation criterion and claimed probe/condition region must have independent provenance from the target performance used as mastery evidence, or be validated on held-out/independent ProbeTransformations; defining the region solely by where the target succeeds cannot establish mastery.
